title: Oil Temperature High Limit
fullDescription: Frymaster fryers (FilterQuick, BIELA, MJCFE, RE series) lock out at E1 when oil temperature exceeds the high-limit. Causes include stuck contactor, runaway gas valve, or failed temperature probe. Hot oil hazard - never service while oil is hot.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Allow oil to fully cool before any service. Hot oil can cause severe burns.

fixSteps.title: Reset high-limit
fixSteps.instruction: Press manual reset on high-limit thermostat once cool.

fixSteps.title: Test probe and contactor
fixSteps.instruction: Verify probe resistance and contactor not welded.

whenToCallPro: Hot oil and gas systems require qualified service tech.

faq.q: Can I just reset and continue?
faq.a: Only after diagnosing root cause; repeated trips lead to fires.

title: Oil Temperature Probe Open
fullDescription: Frymaster E2 fires when the oil temperature probe is reporting an invalid resistance. The fryer cannot heat without valid feedback.

fixSteps.title: Replace probe
fixSteps.instruction: Drain oil, replace probe with OEM part.

whenToCallPro: If probe is good, controller may need service.

faq.a: Yes, oil must be cool and drained for probe replacement.

title: Heating Failure
shortDescription: Oil temperature not rising at expected rate.
fullDescription: E3 fires if the oil does not warm at the expected rate during recovery. Causes include failed heating element, gas valve, contactor, or low oil level.

fixSteps.title: Check oil level
fixSteps.instruction: Top up to fill line with fresh oil.

fixSteps.title: Test elements/contactor
fixSteps.instruction: Power off, drain. Measure resistance per element.

whenToCallPro: Element and gas valve replacement should be done by service tech.

faq.a: Long recovery times and dropping cook temps before lockout.

title: Ignition Failure (Gas)
shortDescription: Burner did not light within trial period.
fullDescription: On gas Frymaster fryers, E4 fires after ignition module fails to confirm flame. Causes include closed gas, dirty ignitor, or failed module.

fixSteps.title: Verify gas supply
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm shutoffs open, inlet pressure correct.

fixSteps.title: Service ignition
fixSteps.instruction: Replace cracked ignitor; clean flame sensor.

whenToCallPro: Gas system work should be done by qualified service.

faq.a: Shut off supply, ventilate, do not operate switches, call gas tech.

title: Filter Pump Fault
shortDescription: Built-in oil filter pump did not run.
fullDescription: FilterQuick and similar Frymaster fryers have integrated filter pumps. E5 fires when the filter pump motor stalls or trips on overload. Causes include clogged filter, debris in pump, or motor overload.

fixSteps.title: Replace filter paper
fixSteps.instruction: Install fresh paper and powder per manual.

fixSteps.title: Reset pump overload
fixSteps.instruction: Press red reset button on pump overload after cooling.

whenToCallPro: Pump motor replacement needs service tech.

faq.a: Behind the front access panel near the pump motor.

title: Oil Level Low
shortDescription: Auto top-off detected low oil reservoir.
fullDescription: FilterQuick AIF (auto-intermittent filtration) fryers monitor oil level. E6 indicates low oil in vat or JIB reservoir. Refill JIB or top up frypot.

fixSteps.title: Refill JIB
fixSteps.instruction: Replace empty oil jug or top up reservoir.

fixSteps.title: Run top-off
fixSteps.instruction: Trigger top-off cycle to refill frypot.

whenToCallPro: If JIB pump fails, service tech needed.

faq.a: Use the oil specified for your menu and frypot type.

title: Drain Valve Open During Heat
shortDescription: Heat cycle started with drain valve open.
fullDescription: E7 prevents heating when the drain valve switch indicates open. Heating an empty pot can warp it and cause fires.
whenToCallPro: If switch is good, control may need service.

title: Filter Pad Missing or Improperly Installed
shortDescription: Filter system detects missing pad or pan.
fullDescription: E8 protects the filter system by preventing operation if the filter pan is missing or pad/paper not installed. Without it, oil and particles reach the pump and clog the system.

fixSteps.title: Reseat filter pan
fixSteps.instruction: Pull pan out and slide back in firmly.

fixSteps.title: Install paper/powder
fixSteps.instruction: Use Frymaster filter paper with magnesol powder.

whenToCallPro: Switch fault rarely; usually operator action only.

faq.a: Filter performance suffers; follow OEM procedure.

title: Flue/Exhaust Fan Fault
shortDescription: Power exhaust fan or flue switch fault on gas fryer.
fullDescription: Power-vented Frymaster gas fryers monitor flue exhaust. E9 fires when fan does not run or pressure switch does not close. Without exhaust, the burner cannot light safely.

fixSteps.title: Check exhaust path
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm hood and flue clear of grease/blockage.

fixSteps.title: Test fan and switch
fixSteps.instruction: Verify fan runs and pressure switch closes during run.

faq.a: Required by code on some installations to ensure proper venting.

title: Communication Error
shortDescription: Display lost communication with main board.
fullDescription: E10 indicates communication breakdown between the M3000/M4000 user interface and the main board. Check harnesses, dry any moisture, and replace board if necessary.

fixSteps.title: Reseat connectors
fixSteps.instruction: Power off; reseat all harnesses on both boards.

whenToCallPro: Board replacement requires service tech with firmware setup.

title: High Limit Exceeded
fullDescription: Frymaster fryers shut down via the high-limit when oil exceeds 425 F (218 C). E03 is a safety lock requiring root-cause investigation.

causes.cause: Failed oil temp probe reading low

fixSteps.title: Verify probe
fixSteps.instruction: Check oil probe in calibrated bath.

fixSteps.title: Reset high-limit
fixSteps.instruction: Press reset button; replace if it re-trips.

whenToCallPro: Hot oil, gas, and high voltage make commercial fryer service hazardous; use a licensed commercial tech. Commercial appliance work in foodservice settings requires a licensed/EPA-certified technician for refrigerant, gas, or high-voltage components.

faq.a: No - safety codes like E03 are critical; bypassing risks a grease fire.

title: Heating Failure
shortDescription: Oil not reaching setpoint within time.
fullDescription: Frymaster controllers monitor the slope of oil temperature. E05 indicates heating is too slow, often a low gas/voltage or failed element/burner issue.

fixSteps.title: Test elements
fixSteps.instruction: Resistance check vs spec on each element.

fixSteps.title: Verify gas pressure
fixSteps.instruction: Manometer test inlet and manifold pressure (gas units).

fixSteps.title: Replace element/burner
fixSteps.instruction: Swap heating element or burner orifice.

fixSteps.title: Install pad

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
